correctness.rationale: The full 96-word constant-GC ambient set is reconstructed. The 72 eligible vertices are obtained by the self reverse-complement condition. Two independent compatibility formulations agree exactly. Complete Bron--Kerbosch enumeration and an independent fixed-size clique census both give maximum 6 and exactly 512 maxima, with no seven-clique. A separate complete search of the ordinary constant-GC graph gives maximum 12 and 128 maxima; filtering and direct reconstruction prove the 16 invariant, 8 viable-parent, and 64-transversal statements. The explicit 256-element symmetry group is generated and verified against the full compatibility graph before orbit counting.

value.rationale: This resolves the complete equality layer at the smallest nontrivial parameter where the classical table has a sharp reverse-complement optimum and a sharp ordinary constant-GC parent optimum. The 8-by-64 decomposition explains exactly how the halving bound is realized and separates viable reverse-complement-invariant parents from the eight invariant ordinary optima obstructed by self-reverse-complement words. The result is therefore a natural structural classification rather than a routine recount of the known optimum.
